svg.title: Integration contract: merge, spectator isolation and consensus
svg.desc: At merge 471f7f7, upstream main eea67d1 (protocol 9, state 11) combines with four-player branch 4b578bf (protocol 8, state 11), producing protocol 10 and state 12. MVC marked state-11 parts use Archive::NextMark. Spectators begin at confirmed state with start and ack set to confirmed, receive four player words and a state hash, and acknowledge only their own cursor. SetAgrees checks all playing links. Mode events are retained until recipients acknowledge them, and are restricted to two-player sessions. These are code contracts, not proof of a four-machine internet match.

g.aria-label: Three boundaries that keep four-player play intact.
4096-frame ring; late join begins at its own snapshot.
Viewer ACKs do not advance player confirmation or timing.
03 / MODE EVENTS STAY QUEUED UNTIL ACKNOWLEDGED
Erase only below min(confirmed, recipient ACKs). Four-player matches retain their mode.
LOCAL TESTS PASS / INTERNET TEST PENDING
